name: mkt-wp-publisher
description: Publish to up to 5 WordPress websites using separate website settings and blog image folders. Developed by Jayant.

website_1_enabled.title: Enable website 1
website_1_enabled.description: Turn on Website 1 after filling its URL, credentials, and blog image folder. Leave unused websites disabled.

website_1_label.title: Website 1 | Website name
website_1_label.description: Friendly name shown to Claude. Its fixed site ID is website-1.

website_1_url.title: Website 1 | WordPress URL
website_1_url.description: Canonical HTTPS WordPress installation URL, without /wp-admin or /wp-json.

website_1_application_password.title: Website 1 | Application Password
website_1_application_password.description: Application Password generated on this website. Enter it here, not in chat.

website_1_image_folder.title: Website 1 | Blog image folder
website_1_image_folder.description: Select this website's local blog image folder. Required when this website is enabled.

sites_json.title: Advanced / previous setup | WordPress sites (JSON)
sites_json.description: Optional, for users of earlier JSON setups (max 5 sites). Enabled Website 1-5 sections override this. Each JSON site may include image_folder. New users should use the website sections above.

site_url.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site URL (legacy)
site_url.description: Optional fallback when WordPress sites JSON is empty. Canonical HTTPS URL.

username.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site username (legacy)
username.description: Used only when WordPress sites JSON is empty.

application_password.title: Advanced / previous setup | Single-site Application Password (legacy)
application_password.description: Used only when WordPress sites JSON is empty. Enter it here, not in chat.

image_folder.title: Advanced / previous setup | Blog image folder
image_folder.description: Fallback only for previous JSON/single-site setup. Website 1-5 sections each use their own required folder.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List named websites and URLs without credentials.

tools.name: list_authors
tools.description: Read people who can be set as a post author.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List images in the website's blog image folder.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Find drafts, posts or pages by title or status.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read a post or page for review, including SEO fields.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local PNG, JPG, or WebP.

tools.name: create_term
tools.description: Create a category or tag (no duplicates).

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create a draft post or page (HTML or Markdown, optional author and SEO fields).

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Update a draft post or page, including its author and SEO fields.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Publish a draft on explicit request; the title must be confirmed.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a draft for a future date and time; the title must be confirmed.
